name: magpie-agent-antigravity-ide
description: Magpie Agent plugin for the native Antigravity IDE chat, with independent Google and Magpie CLI sessions on Windows.
author: qwt1011

summary.zh: 在 Antigravity IDE 原生侧栏切换 Magpie 模型与 Google 账号；CLI 来源独立。仅支持 Windows IDE 2.7.0，需额外安装本地适配。
summary.en: Use Magpie models or your Google account in Antigravity IDE native chat, with independent CLI sources. Windows IDE 2.7.0 only; local setup required.
